description: This PHP script manages platform configurations within the TestLink project, including creating, editing, updating, deleting, and enabling/disabling platforms. It handles user interface initialization, security checks, and database interactions related to platform management.

classes.name: tlPlatform
classes.description: Class handling platform database operations and validation within TestLink.

methods.name: initEnv
methods.description: Initializes environment, security, and platform management objects.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes request arguments for platform operations.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Prepares interface variables for creating a new platform.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Prepares interface variables for editing an existing platform.

methods.name: do_create
methods.description: Performs database insertion for a new platform.

methods.name: do_update
methods.description: Performs database update for an existing platform.

methods.name: do_delete
methods.description: Deletes a platform and associated data from the database.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns user-friendly error messages based on error codes.

methods.name: init_gui
methods.description: Initializes GUI variables for platform management.

methods.name: checkPageAccess
methods.description: Checks user permissions for platform management page.
